paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
notes: BASE cryogenic Penning trap haloscope using antiproton superconducting detection circuit. Constrains ALP-photon coupling g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP masses 2.7906-2.7914 neV. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
